items.title: 边界设备Web管理命令注入
items.title_zh: 边界设备Web管理命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过Web管理接口的group_name参数注入系统命令，可能导致设备被远程控制。
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；无法升级时禁用Web管理外网访问并限制管理面。
items.repro_note: Web管理界面提交group_name参数，用命令分隔符验证；需管理面可达
items.impact_scope: 边界设备管理面，常暴露公网
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507_2.0.0. This issue affects the function sub_41a1d8 of the file /bin/ioos of the component WireGuard CLI Group Handler. Such manipulation of the argument group_name leads to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: Web管理界面group_name命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过Web管理界面的group_name参数注入系统命令，远程执行任意命令并控制设备。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本；临时禁用Web管理外网访问并限制管理面。
items.repro_note: Web管理界面group_name参数经/bin/ioos处理，命令分隔符注入
items.impact_scope: 设备Web管理面，暴露公网风险高
items.description: A weakness has been identified in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507_2.0.0. This vulnerability affects the function sub_416760 of the file /bin/ioos of the component Web Management Interface. This manipulation of the argument group_name causes os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
